docs.title: Installation & Setup
docs.text: Welcome to Serow! This guide will help you get started with installing or accessing Serow for the first time.

docs.title: 1. Accessing Serow
docs.text:
For web-based application. You don’t need to install heavy software to use it.

  • Open your browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge).
  • Go to https://serow.app.
  • Sign up for a new account or log in if you already have one.

docs.title: 1. Download the Latest Release
docs.text:
1. Visit https://serow.app.
  2. Navigate to the Downloads section.
  3. Choose the latest version of Serow for your platform:
  4. Windows (.exe)
  5. macOS (.dmg)
  6. Linux (.AppImage / .deb / .rpm)

💡 Always download the latest stable release to ensure you have new features and security updates.

docs.title: 2. Creating an Account
docs.text:
1. Click Sign Up on the homepage.
  2. Provide your business name, email address, and password.
  3. select server
  4. Verify your email by clicking the link sent to your inbox.
  5. Log in using your new credentials.

docs.title: 3. Initial Configuration
docs.text:
After logging in, set up your workspace:

  • Business details: name, location, currency, tax settings.
  • Inventory preferences: categories, units of measurement, stock thresholds.
  • Notification settings: choose how you want to receive alerts (email, in-app, SMS).

docs.title: 4. Adding Your First Inventory Item
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the Inventory section.
  2. Click Add Item.
  3. Enter details:
  4. Item name
  5. SKU (optional but recommended)
  6. Quantity in stock
  7. Unit price
  8. Supplier (if applicable)
  9. Save the item.

docs.title: 5. Mobile App (Optional)
docs.text:
If Serow provides a mobile app:

  • Android: Download from Google Play Store
  • iOS: Download from Apple App Store
  • Log in using your Serow account.

docs.title: 6. Self-Hosted (Advanced)
docs.text:
⚠️ Only for enterprise customers who need on-premise installation.

Requirements: - Docker + Docker Compose - PostgreSQL database - Minimum server specs: 2 CPU, 4GB RAM, 20GB disk

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Serow is a POS system (ERP) that has been build by to tech Engineers to incorporate data engineering , Inteligence , Design and security to transform business management work flow.

Serow manages your business processes seamlessly from inventory management, accounts, Point of Sale and other aspects of your business intelligently, giving your team more power
